DesignOps Skill

User Feedback Analysis

Transform raw user feedback into structured, prioritised UX findings — with automated severity scoring, live visual verification, and Nielsen heuristic correlation.

What It Does

📊

Ingest Any Format

Accepts CSV, plain text, JSON, or pasted survey responses. Automatically normalises ratings and strips metadata.

🏷️

Categorise & Cluster

Classifies feedback by UX category (Navigation, Performance, Forms, etc.), sentiment, and clusters duplicate items together.

⚖️

Priority Scoring

Computes a Frequency × Severity matrix and assigns each issue to a quadrant: Critical, Investigate, Monitor, or Backlog.

🔍

Live Visual Verification

Opens the application in a browser, navigates to reported problem areas, captures screenshots, and confirms or refutes findings.

🧪

Nielsen Heuristic Mapping

Maps each finding to relevant Nielsen heuristics with confidence levels — connecting user pain points to established usability principles.

📄

HTML Report Generation

Produces a professional Density-styled HTML report with findings cards, priority matrix, screenshots, and actionable recommendations.

How It Works

Step 0 — Gather Inputs

Collects app name, feedback data, and optional URL or existing audit report from the user.

Step 1 — Ingest & Parse

Reads feedback in any supported format, normalises ratings to a 1–5 scale, and confirms item count.

Step 2 — Categorise & Classify

Assigns UX categories (NAV, PERF, FORM…), classifies sentiment, and clusters near-duplicates.

Step 3 — Score Severity & Frequency

Calculates priority score using weighted formula: (severity × 0.6) + (frequency × 0.4). Maps to quadrants.

Step 4 — Map to Nielsen Heuristics

Correlates findings to established usability principles with confidence ratings.

Step 5 — Live Visual Verification

Opens the app in a browser, navigates to affected areas, captures screenshots, and assigns verification status.

Step 6 — Correlate with Existing Audit

Cross-references findings with a prior Nielsen audit report. Elevates severity for confirmed issues.

Step 7 — Generate HTML Report

Produces a professional Density-styled report with all findings, screenshots, priority matrix, and recommendations.

Priority Quadrants

Every finding is placed into one of four action quadrants based on its combined severity and frequency score:

🔴 Critical

High severity + High frequency. Fix immediately — these issues affect many users severely.

🟡 Investigate

High severity + Low frequency OR Low severity + High frequency. Needs further analysis.

🔵 Monitor

Medium severity + Medium frequency. Track over time and address in upcoming sprints.

⚪ Backlog

Low severity + Low frequency. Log for future consideration — minimal current impact.

When to Use This Skill

  • After collecting user survey responses or app store reviews
  • When a product team needs to prioritise UX fixes for the next sprint
  • To validate qualitative feedback with visual evidence from the live app
  • To connect user complaints to established usability heuristics
  • When combining user feedback insights with a prior UX audit report
  • To generate a shareable report for stakeholder alignment
